_note: Save B exercises the validators in includes/ReverseWithdrawal/Admin/Settings.php::validate_admin_settings (hooked on dokan_before_saving_settings @ priority 20). All requests are POST /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php action=dokan_save_settings section=dokan_reverse_withdrawal. Nonce stripped as <window.dokan.nonce>.

B1_disable_while_keeping_other_fields.side_effects: Both dokan_reverse_withdrawal_midnight_cron and dokan_reverse_withdrawal_monthly_cron pending Action Scheduler entries CLEARED (as_unschedule_all_actions called in CronActions::after_save_settings + CronActions::schedule_action when SettingsHelper::is_enabled() returns false).
B1_disable_while_keeping_other_fields.verdict: ACCEPTED. Validation does NOT short-circuit when enabled=off — all other field values still persist verbatim. Crons get unscheduled.

B9_empty_option_default.command: wp option delete dokan_reverse_withdrawal; then dokan_get_setting_values AJAX
B9_empty_option_default.verdict: Empty PHP array. No filter injection — no defaults are applied at read time (unlike dokan_withdraw's paypal-only injection). The plugin-ui code must drive defaults from the field schema, NOT from the option payload.
